description: Issue a Warrant (spend mandate) for an Agent-Rider identity, capping what an agent may spend, where, and for how long. Mutating: mints a signed token. Pass a Rider JWT, or demo:true for a 10-minute shape check that issues nothing billable. Use to authorize an agent's spending before it acts; use spl_warrant_verify to check a token, spl_warrant_reserve to hold funds, spl_warrant_receipt to settle.

actions.description: Allowed action names, e.g. ["compress", "quote"]. Omit for no action restriction.

allow_hosts.description: Allowed hostnames the agent may call. Omit for no host restriction.

demo.description: True for a 10-minute shape check without a Rider token. Defaults to false.

max_calls.description: Maximum number of calls under this Warrant. Omit for no cap.

max_usd.description: Maximum spend in USD across the Warrant's life. Omit for no cap.

rider.description: Agent-Rider JWT proving the identity the Warrant is issued for. Required unless demo is true.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds. Demo defaults to 600 (10 minutes).

name: spl_warrant_issue
